u0: No unresolved key-door obligation; this is the accepting final RM state. The agent either is not carrying the matching key, or is carrying it while the door is already open. Compliance is currently satisfied. Continue the mission: if the closed door must still be crossed, obtain the matching key and open the door, accepting that the key-held/closed-door situation will temporarily enter u1. If the key is held while the door is open, keep the door open and drop the key when needed so the target box can be picked up. This RM state is not itself an episode termination; the episode ends only when the mission box is picked up.
u1: Unresolved key-door obligation; this is a non-final state. The agent has held the matching key while the door was closed, and the door has not yet been opened. This state persists even if the key is dropped, so losing the key does not clear the obligation. The immediate objective is to have the matching key in hand if it was lost, reach the door, and toggle it open; opening the door resolves the obligation and returns to u0. Entering this state incurs the penalty, while opening the door earns the recovery reward. Only picking up the mission box ends the environment episode.
